objective: Execute the exact four-route v18 tensor payload repackaged as one signed v19 artifact on CPU and CUDA. Require exact ordinary-output conformance against all 1,400 immutable V526 development rows, then test the frozen 400-row model-blind metamorphic suite through the new constrained host without assuming that this Phase 3 endpoint reproduces the later 14-route adapted diagnostic.
decision_rule: Pass only if the same signed archive and exact v18 tensor payload execute on CPU and CUDA; all nine ordinary fields match V526 on 1,400/1,400 rows per device; CPU and CUDA ordinary outputs are identical; prospective quality reaches point >=0.90, Wilson lower-95 >=0.85, and every namespace and family >=0.80 on both devices; CPU and CUDA prospective outputs are identical; every prospective row uses six evaluator-blind candidates, one persistent batched scoring forward, and one active residual route; collapse is zero; package verification passes; receiver learning is zero; and no teacher, training, candidate construction, or final data is used.
failure_rule: If ordinary conformance passes but prospective quality fails, attribute the result to the four-route Phase 3 endpoint not reproducing the separately measured 14-route adapted diagnostic. Preserve the failure and specify a separately versioned 14-route host/artifact; do not mutate v19 or blame the sealed LayerCake product.
claim_boundary: Same-artifact ordinary conformance and frozen prospective quality screen only. Timing and memory are descriptive, not a repeated performance certificate; stable frontier, matched baselines, final test, Phase 4, and superiority remain unproven.
